summary: the thermal energy k_B T of a temperature, in joules

outputs.name: thermal_energy
outputs.meaning: the Boltzmann constant times the temperature

validity: any absolute temperature; the Boltzmann constant is exact in the SI since 2019, so the product carries no uncertainty of its own

source.citation: NIST, CODATA Value: Boltzmann constant, 2022 CODATA recommended values (read 2026-11-21, https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?k; mat-20261121-nist-codata-boltzmann-constant)
source.locus: Numerical value 1.380 649 x 10^-23 J K^-1, standard uncertainty (exact)

note: Written for meta_agent/tasks/031, where an MD engine's thermostat takes kT in the engine's energy unit: this skill gives joules, and unit_convert@v1 takes them to the engine's unit through a scale the person confirmed. The constant is the source's; each case is worked by hand on its own kind of system.
